name: bootstrap-validate
description: A simple Form Validation Utility for Bootstrap 3, Bootstrap 4, and Bootstrap 5 for Humans.
author: Pascale Beier <mail@pascalebeier.de>

scripts.build: vite build && tsc --project tsconfig.json && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs
scripts.check-style: oxlint --vitest-plugin astro.config.mjs vite.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs scripts/ src/ docs-site/ tests/ && oxfmt --check astro.config.mjs vite.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs "scripts/**/*.mjs" "src/**/*.ts" "!src/rules.ts" "docs-site/**/*.js" "tests/**/*.js"
scripts.fix-style: oxlint --fix --vitest-plugin astro.config.mjs vite.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs scripts/ src/ docs-site/ tests/ && oxfmt --write astro.config.mjs vite.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs "scripts/**/*.mjs" "src/**/*.ts" "!src/rules.ts" "docs-site/**/*.js" "tests/**/*.js"
scripts.docs-build: npm run docs-generate && astro build && node scripts/create-legacy-docs.mjs && node scripts/verify-docs.mjs
